data.name: Call the Cat
data.detailed_description:
Call the Cat is a casual cat game where you can bond with adorable cats through a variety of mini-games and a new roguelite mode.

Use items cats love, such as treats, catnip, and yarn, to get their attention and enjoy five different mini-games.

Each cat has its own personality and unique reactions. Spend time together, discover new behaviors, and increase your bond.

Earn points through mini-games and other activities, then unlock new outfits and additional content to customize your cats.

You can also enter the new roguelite mode, Call the Cat: Dream.

Take direct control of your cat in a mysterious dream world, battle a variety of monsters, and choose new abilities as you grow stronger during each run.

Face slimes, food-themed monsters, dangerous hazards, and powerful bosses. Combine different abilities and challenge increasingly difficult battles.

Enjoy the game in two different ways: relax and bond with your cats through casual mini-games, or enter the dream world for fast-paced roguelite combat and progression.

Features

• Five cat-themed mini-games

• New roguelite mode, Call the Cat: Dream

• Choose abilities and grow stronger during each run

• Battle various monsters and bosses

• Cats with different personalities and reactions

• Bond progression and unlockable content

• Earn points and collect different outfits

• Relaxing casual gameplay and challenging combat

• Supports Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese, and Spanish

Spend time with adorable cats, discover their unique reactions, and begin a new adventure inside the dream world.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible graphics
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.10 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or Apple Silicon
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal compatible GPU
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Supports Intel and Apple Silicon Macs.
